LESSON: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.6: Sound ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Sound ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different sounds ( 5 Lessons) environment, 143
2. talk about different sounds in their immediate environment,
3. imitate sounds in their immediate environment,
4. appreciate the different sounds in the environment. by playing with different objects or items in their immediate environment related to sounds in the environment play while producing different sounds in the environment Core-Competences to be developed: Links to Pertinent and contemporary Issues(PCI’s): environmental awareness

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.
